title: Maamkuzi na Maagano (Theme 2: Nidhamu mezani)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child decides who is greeted, at what time and whether arriving or leaving, then chooses the greeting and its reply.
representations: a chart of greetings and replies
a clock for time of day
steps: Say the greeting and wait for the reply.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child acts out greeting an elder and a friend, with the right reply each time.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mtu akikusalimia "Hujambo?", unajibu "___."" Kwa nini "Hujambo" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Hujambo hujibiwa kwa "Sijambo". Shikamoo hujibiwa kwa "Marahaba".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kabla ya kulala usiku unamwambia mama, "___."" Kwa nini "Habari za asubuhi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: "Habari za asubuhi" ni ya asubuhi. "Usiku mwema" husemwa usiku kabla ya kulala.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Unamsalimia babu yako kwa kusema "___."" Kwa nini "Hujambo" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Mdogo humsalimia mkubwa kwa "Shikamoo", na mkubwa hujibu "Marahaba". "Hujambo" ni ya rika moja.

checks.question: Mzee akikusalimu "Shikamoo" ni wewe unayesema, yeye hujibu nini?
